response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.name AS race_name, p.avg_points AS avg_points, p.avg_points - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_points > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: Races are grouped by races.name (each distinct race name once, across all years), as the request says, not by raceId or year.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-race-name averages, not the mean over all kept entries.
